competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times and recovers 10% of the Attack Bar each time the attack lands as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns to the target enemy and sets up a bomb to blow up after 2 turns. Instantly gains another turn after using this skill.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

When remaining turns reach 0, the bomb explodes to deal damage that ignores Defense and stuns for 1 turn. The damage is affected by the caster's Attack Power, and the chance of stunning is affected by the caster's Accuracy and the target's Resistance.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects and stuns them for 1 turn with a 75% chance. The enemies with beneficial effects removed are guaranteed to be stunned for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
